BG-1.1.translation: On the holy field of Kurukṣetra, assembled together, eager to fight...

BG-1.2.text: Marjayante mahā-bhāgā / bhīṣmaṁ ca droṇam ca mādhavam
BG-1.2.translation: O Sañjaya, after my sons and the sons of Pandu assembled...

BG-2.47.translation: Yoga is skill in action. Perform your duty with detachment, abandoning concern for results.

BG-3.35.text: Śreyān svabhāvo guṇavān / tat sangas tu sadoṣavat
BG-3.35.translation: It is far better to discharge one's prescribed duty imperfectly than another's duty well.

BG-4.13.translation: According to the three modes of material nature and the work associated with them, the four divisions of human society are created.

BG-6.46.translation: And of all yogis, he who always abides in Me with great faith, worshiping Me in transcendental loving service, is most intimately united with Me.

BG-13.2.text: Kṣetrajñaṁ cāpi māṁ viddhi / sarva-kṣetreṣu bhārata
BG-13.2.translation: O Bharata, you should understand that I am also the knower in all bodies.

BG-18.66.text: Sarva-dharmān parityajya / mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
BG-18.66.translation: Abandon all varieties of religion and just surrender unto Me. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions.

Isha-1.text: Īśāvāsyam idaṁ sarvaṁ / yat kiñca jagatyāṁ jagat
Isha-1.translation: All of this is to be covered by the Lord. Whatever exists in this universe is the property of the Lord.

Katha-2.3.1.text: Ātmānaṁ rathinaṁ viddhi / śarīraṁ ratham eva ca
Katha-2.3.1.translation: Know the self as master of the chariot, and the body as the chariot itself.

Mundaka-2.2.11.translation: One who knows Brahman becomes Brahman itself.

Chandogya-3.14.1.translation: Thou art That - the ultimate reality is the same as your innermost self.

BS-1.1.1.translation: Now, therefore, the inquiry into Brahman - the ultimate reality and source of all existence.

BS-1.1.2.translation: Brahman is that from which all beings are born, by which they live, and into which they finally return.
